text:
The largest recorded tree-cover loss event on this property was in 2020, at about 67.7 ha (Hansen Global Forest Change data). Earlier events were smaller: 25.5 ha in 2015, 4.8 ha in 2017 and 0.8 ha in 2008.

Two caveats:

- The 2020 event falls before the 2020-12-31 baseline, so it is historical and outside the 2021–2025 assessment window.
- In that 2021–2025 window, no loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected. The only loss was about 0.4 ha in 2021, in patches below the event threshold.

Small changes (under 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels) may be missed. This says nothing about regulatory compliance or about periods outside the evaluated one.
